sentences.en: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯对人质事件中遇难者表示遗憾。

sentences.en: The journalists in Russia are not free, are not independent.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的记者并不自由，也不独立。

sentences.en: Lake Baikal in Russia is the deepest lake in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上最深的湖是俄罗斯的贝加尔湖。
